fields.Name: T147 - MCP Server Card Expand Tools
fields.Description: Tests the server-card expand/collapse behavior (toggleServerExpand + isServerExpanded) and the nested per-server tools listing — a distinct expandable-card code path.

InputDefinition.goal: Assume you are already logged in at http://localhost:4200. Open the AI app via the application switcher dropdown next to the logo (NOT Ctrl+K), open the MCP section, and stay on the Servers tab. If any server cards are shown, click a server card header (the chevron/name area) to expand it and confirm it reveals the server's detail grid (Transport, Auth, Connections, Tools counts) and an 'Available Tools (N)' section listing that server's tools or a 'No tools discovered yet' message. Success is that expanding a server card reveals its expanded tools section; if no servers are configured, a 'No MCP servers configured' empty state is an acceptable outcome. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: The Servers tab shows server cards, OR a valid 'No MCP servers configured' empty state
Clicking a server card header expands it to show detail fields (Transport, Auth, Connections, Tools) and an 'Available Tools' section (when at least one server exists)
The expand arrow/state visibly toggles when the card is expanded and collapsed
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
